title: Is Subsequence
timeComplexity: O(n), n is the length of t
description:
Given strings s and t, return true if s is a subsequence of t, meaning s can be obtained from t by deleting some characters without changing the order of the rest.

Example 1:
Input: s = "abc", t = "ahbgdc"
Output: true

Example 2:
Input: s = "axc", t = "ahbgdc"
Output: false

Constraints:
- 0 ≤ len(s) ≤ 100
- 0 ≤ len(t) ≤ 10^4
- Both strings consist of lowercase English letters
idea: Two pointers: i over s, j over t. Walk t; when the characters match, advance i as well. If i reaches the end of s, all its characters were found in t in order.
